name: Nathaniel Brewster
bioAdditions: Thompson (S1) states that Rev. Nathaniel Brewster's wife was a daughter of Roger Ludlow, deputy-governor of Massachusetts and framer of Connecticut's code, and that their daughter Hannah married John Muncy and then Samuel Thompson.

sources.citation: B. F. Thompson, History of Long Island, 3rd ed. (1918), vol. 3 (archive.org full text), p. 296
sources.supports: Rev. Nathaniel Brewster's wife a daughter of Roger Ludlow; daughter Hannah

researchLogEntry: Round 4: Ludlow marriage noted from Thompson; kinship unchanged.
